items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: That's right. And I worked with Andrew Morgan. Was the same outfit with the exception of Idru Coleman?

ctx.x: When you came back to the Melody Inn when I had the band in charge, this man would close up and went back to the Happy Land. Yeah, that's right. And then when he came back to the Happy Land, the Melody Inn opened again, I went back to the Melody Inn. And that's where I put Andrew Morgan in my place at the Happy Land.
That's right. And I worked with Andrew Morgan. Was the same outfit with the exception of Idru Coleman?

Yeah, I have a picture of your book in there with Andrew Morgan. Did you have it? Yeah, I have a picture of it. I'd sure like to see it. Yeah, I'll get you a copy of that one. I'll get back. Listen, did you ever make any recordings other than the one with Harold?
